Today is `origin/main` at `4fa2fa523ca`. "After" is the Python plan (`2026-09-25-python-startup-policy.md`) plus the core PR it depends on. In the "after" diagrams, [yellow]{style="background:#fff4ce;padding:0 4px"} marks a step that changed and [green]{style="background:#dff3e0;padding:0 4px"} marks a new one.

## Terms

**Startup behavior.** Each runtime Python registers carries one of these. It says when Positron may start that runtime without being asked:

| Behavior | Starts |
|---|---|
| `Immediate` | As soon as Positron sees it, when the folder opens |
| `Implicit` | The first time Python is needed: a `.py` file is opened, code is run (for example Run Line with no console), or Quarto or a notebook asks for a Python kernel |
| `Explicit` | Only when the user picks it, in the interpreter picker or the console's start button |

**`interpreters.startupBehavior`.** The user setting that controls startup for every language; `"[python]": { "interpreters.startupBehavior": ... }` overrides it for Python. Values:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `auto` (default) | Start the affiliated runtime if there is one, otherwise the recommendation |
| `recommended` ("recommended mode") | Start only the recommendation; ignore the affiliated runtime |
| `always` | Always start a runtime for the language, even in a folder with no files for it |
| `manual` | Never start one automatically |
| `disabled` | Don't discover or start the language at all |

**Affiliated runtime.** The interpreter last used in this folder, which core remembers and starts again next time (under `auto` and `always`).

**0/0 affiliation.** Today, when a recommendation is not `Immediate`, core saves it as the folder's affiliated runtime with both timestamps set to 0. A lone affiliation starts on the next open regardless of its timestamps, so a recommendation that wasn't meant to start now does start next time. After this change Python opts out of that save; R doesn't.

**Recommendation.** The one interpreter per language that the language's extension suggests for this folder. Python's is the top eligible interpreter in the ranking below.

**Startup ask and follow-up ask.** During startup, core asks every language for its recommendation once (the *startup ask*) and waits for all the answers before it starts discovery. After this change Python answers the startup ask using only interpreters it can find by path, without a full scan, so it answers within a couple of seconds at most (usually much less) instead of waiting for the full scan and holding up R and the cached runtimes. If none of those interpreters is usable, it answers "nothing yet". Core then asks Python a second time once discovery has finished (the *follow-up ask*), and Python ranks everything discovery found.

**Discovery.** Finding every interpreter on the machine. PET (python-environment-tools) does the scan for Python. The discovery cache lets core show interpreters from the last session before the scan finishes.

**Root env.** An environment directly in the folder's root: `.venv`, `.conda`, `venv`, `.virtualenv`, or `.pixi/envs/<name>`. An env one folder further down (for example `app/.venv`) is not a root env.

**Python folder.** A folder with a root env, or with any of these at the root or one level down: `*.py`, `*.ipynb`, `pyproject.toml`, a `requirements*.txt`, `Pipfile`, `setup.py`, `setup.cfg`, `environment.yml`, `.python-version`, `uv.lock`, `pixi.toml`.

## The ranking (after)

The recommendation is the first interpreter in this order that passes the filters (`python.interpreters.exclude` and `override`, a supported Python version, and a compatible ipykernel unless it's the project's own env).

| Tier | Interpreter | What it is | Startup behavior of the recommendation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Launch-shell env | The env that was active in the terminal Positron was started from (`VIRTUAL_ENV`, or a non-base `CONDA_PREFIX`) | `Immediate` in a Python folder, otherwise `Implicit` |
| 1 | `python.defaultInterpreterPath` | The interpreter set in settings, at any scope, including an admin-enforced value | Same |
| 2 | Root env, then the pyenv virtualenv named in `.python-version` | The project's own env (see Terms) | Same |
| 3 | The pyenv version named in `.python-version` | For example `3.12.4` in the file, installed with `pyenv install` | Same |
| 4 | Envs one level deep, then other envs inside the folder | `app/.venv`, or a poetry or hatch env stored inside the folder | Same |
| 5 | Configured | `interpreters.definitions` > environment modules > `python.interpreters.include` > `python.venvPath` > `python.venvFolders` | Same |
| 6 | Positron's default env | `~/.virtualenvs/positron`, or under `$WORKON_HOME` | Same |
| 7 | Named envs | Envs a tool created and named, outside the folder: conda envs (`conda create -n ds`), then pyenv virtualenvs (`pyenv virtualenv 3.12 tool`) | Same |
| 8 | Global envs | Shared Pythons not tied to any project: uv base Pythons (`uv python install`), then conda base (the Python that comes with Anaconda or Miniconda), then pyenv versions (`pyenv install`), then global virtualenvs (`~/.virtualenvs/<name>`, virtualenvwrapper, and poetry, pipenv, hatch or uv envs stored outside the folder) | Same |
| 9 | Base installs | python.org installers, the Windows Store and registry, other Pythons on `PATH` | `Explicit` |
| 10 | Externally managed and system | Homebrew, Xcode Command Line Tools, distro `/usr/bin`, anything with a PEP 668 `EXTERNALLY-MANAGED` marker | `Explicit` |

**"Recommended, but only when picked" (tiers 9-10).** If the best interpreter on the machine is a python.org, Homebrew or system Python, it is still the recommendation: it is shown first in the interpreter picker, and `always` uses it. But its startup behavior is `Explicit`, so opening the folder, opening a `.py` file or running code never starts it on its own. The user has to pick it once; after that it is the folder's affiliated runtime and starts like any other.

Every other interpreter is registered `Explicit`.

## 1. Who calls whom

Core talks to the Python extension through the extension host; those hops are left out.

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="49%"}
### Today

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"theme": "default", "themeVariables": {"background": "#ffffff", "fontSize": "15px", "clusterBkg": "#f6f8fa", "clusterBorder": "#d0d7de"}, "sequence": {"wrap": true, "width": 120, "actorMargin": 20, "boxMargin": 4, "noteMargin": 6, "messageMargin": 28, "mirrorActors": false, "messageFontSize": 15, "noteFontSize": 14}}}%%
sequenceDiagram
    participant Core
    participant Py as Python extension
    participant PET
    participant Sup as Supervisor

    Core->>Core: Restore sessions: running ones reconnect, exited ones are retried,<br/>disabled languages are dropped
    opt Affiliated runtime, setting is auto or always
        Core->>Py: validateMetadata(stored runtime)
        Core->>Sup: Start the affiliated console
    end
    Core->>Py: recommendedWorkspaceRuntime()
    Py->>Py: findFiles .venv, .conda, */bin/python (slow)
    Py->>PET: Resolve the path (refresh and retry on failure)
    Py-->>Core: Metadata
    alt Immediate
        Core->>Sup: Start it
    else Not Immediate
        Core->>Core: Save as 0/0 affiliation
    end
    Note over Core: Every language waits for this answer
    Core->>Core: Replay the discovery cache
    Core->>Py: discoverAllRuntimes()
    Py->>PET: triggerRefresh (full scan)
    PET-->>Py: Environments
    Py->>Py: Sort by env type, findFiles **/*.py,<br/>ipykernel check per interpreter
    Py-->>Core: Runtimes: first sorted Immediate, the rest Implicit
    Core->>Sup: At Complete, start the first Immediate
    Note over Core,Sup: File opened with no console:<br/>first registered Implicit runtime starts
```

:::

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="49%"}
### Today

```{mermaid}

flowchart TD
    A[Window opens] --> B[Restore sessions<br/>running ones reconnect,<br/>exited ones are retried,<br/>disabled languages are dropped]
    B --> C{Console running?}
    C -- no --> D{Affiliated runtime<br/>and setting is<br/>auto or always?}
    D -- yes --> E[Start affiliated runtime]
    D -- no --> F
    E --> F{Console running?}
    F -- no --> G[Ask each language<br/>for a recommendation]
    G --> H{Immediate?}
    H -- yes --> I[Start it]
    H -- no --> J[Save as 0/0 affiliation:<br/>starts on next open]
    C -- yes --> K
    F -- yes --> K
    I --> K
    J --> K
    K[Discovery: cache replay,<br/>then each extension]
    K --> L[Complete: start first Immediate,<br/>or first runtime of an always language]
```

### After

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"theme": "default", "themeVariables": {"background": "#ffffff", "fontSize": "15px", "clusterBkg": "#f6f8fa", "clusterBorder": "#d0d7de"}}}%%
flowchart TD
    A[Window opens] --> B[Restore sessions<br/>every running session reconnects,<br/>even an excluded interpreter or<br/>a disabled language. One whose<br/>kernel has exited isn't retried]
    B --> C{Console running?}
    C -- no --> D{Affiliated runtime<br/>and setting is<br/>auto or always?}
    D -- yes --> E[Start affiliated runtime<br/>Python refuses if excluded<br/>skipped when the setting is recommended]
    D -- no --> F

    F -- no --> G[Startup ask: each language<br/>recommends one runtime<br/>Python uses only interpreters it<br/>can find by path, no full scan]

    H -- no --> J[Remember it<br/>no 0/0 save for Python]
    C -- yes --> K
    F -- yes --> K
    I --> K
    J --> K
    K[Discovery: cache replay,<br/>then each extension]
    K --> L[Follow-up ask: Python again,<br/>if its startup ask answered nothing<br/>or was skipped]
    L --> M{Immediate, and no<br/>console for it?}
    M -- yes --> N[Start it]
    M -- no --> O[Remember it: starts when<br/>Python is first needed if Implicit,<br/>only when picked if Explicit]

    classDef changed fill:#fff4ce,stroke:#bf8700,color:#1f2328

    class B,E,G,J changed

```

:::

::::

"Skipped" means a console was already starting, for example an affiliated R console: today Python isn't asked at all then, so it has no recommendation. R is unchanged: it doesn't opt out of the 0/0 save, and it never answers "nothing yet".

## 3. What starts a Python runtime

:::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="49%"}
### Today

```{mermaid}
%%{init: {"theme": "default", "themeVariables": {"background": "#ffffff", "fontSize": "15px", "clusterBkg": "#f6f8fa", "clusterBorder": "#d0d7de"}}}%%
flowchart TD
    subgraph Marked["Which runtimes may start"]
        direction TB
        R1[Recommendation: Immediate if<br/>.venv, .conda or */bin/python]
        R2[Discovery: first sorted interpreter<br/>Immediate if the folder has Python files]
        R3[Every other interpreter: Implicit<br/>Explicit if no ipykernel]
    end
    subgraph Triggers["What starts one"]
        direction TB
        T1[Affiliated runtime registered]
        T2[Immediate runtime registered<br/>or discovery completes]
        T3[File opened, no console:<br/>first registered Implicit runtime]
        T4[Setting is always:<br/>first registered runtime]
    end
    R1 ~~~ R2 ~~~ R3
    T1 ~~~ T2 ~~~ T3 ~~~ T4
    Marked --> Triggers
```
:::

### After
